decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation launched in 2023 builds on the firm's established automation offer and fits its digital, energy-recovery direction, and with too little evidence yet of a shortfall against aspirations, the firm's R&D slack lets management keep it.
A web tool for weir dimensioning costs little to maintain, supports the core flood-control business by engaging planners, and is unlikely to trigger problemistic search.
The fouling detection system is closely tied to Product A and to the firm's research activity, so management would carry it while results are still uncertain rather than drop it after only one year.
